The home page lists the address (15131 Hwy 119, Black Hawk, CO 80422) and phone (303-582-5777) and three program pages: Pumpkin Decorating Contest (dated 2026: drop-off 1-23 October, voting from 26 October, winners noon 30 October, pickup by 4 pm 6 November), Cultural Pass, and Mountain Meditation Circle (Mondays 6 pm, free, community room, no end date). sources.name: Colorado Parks and Wildlife: Golden Gate Canyon State Park (cpw.state.co.us)
sources.defaultVenue: Golden Gate Canyon State Park, 92 Crawford Gulch Road, Golden, CO 80403
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026 (the old /placestogo/parks/GoldenGateCanyon path also answered with the same page). The park page gives the address, 303-582-3707, day use 5 am-10 pm, visitor center daily 9 am-4 pm, campground office 10 am-5 pm, $12-$17 daily vehicle pass, 12,119 acres, 35 miles of trails, 156 campsites, 125 picnic sites, fall weekend capacity by 9 am, the Visitor Center lot closed Friday and Saturday evenings mid-September to mid-October, and paving notices for Highway 46 (from Sept. 1) and Crawford Gulch Road (from Monday, September 21) without a year. Its one dated event is Free Park Entry for Veterans and Active Military, 11 November 2026, 8 am-10 pm, statewide; that page says both that registration is and is not required. CPW's events list is at https://cpw.state.co.us/events (not fetched).

sources.name: Gilpin Historical Society (gilpinhistory.org)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. Everything the society runs is in Central City, next door: the Gilpin History Museum (228 E. First High St.), Thomas House (209 Eureka St.) and the Washington Hall tour office (117 Eureka St.), all from the hours-and-locations page, which gives seasons by holiday (Memorial Day weekend to end of September daily 10-4; October to Memorial Day by appointment or Tues-Sun 10-4 for the tour office) and $10 adult admission. The home page says the museum is closed for the season and gives 303-582-5283. The 2026 events page lists Creepy Crawl: Valentine's Edition (7 February), museum opening 23 May, Cemetery Crawl 22 August, museum closing 27 September, and the 17th Annual Creepy Crawl 16, 17, 23 and 24 October (tours from 6:30 pm every 30 minutes to 8:30 pm from the Century Casino, 102 Main St., Central City; tickets on Eventbrite). Both the museum and the Creepy Crawl are in staging because they are in Central City.
